additionalInfo.description: Chi tiep tuc neu tim duoc Home Asset co automation rules
Core engine: evaluate tat ca conditions. Dung metadata.originatorId (UUID tu TbGetOriginatorFieldsNode) de so sanh voi device_id trong rule.
Chi tiep tuc neu co rule duoc trigger
Lay action dau tien tu triggered rules va luu tat ca actions vao metadata.pendingActions
Route action toi node xu ly tuong ung
Chuyen action device_command thanh RPC request. Luu targetDeviceName de TbChangeOriginatorNode doi originator sang dung thiet bi dich.

Doi originator sang thiet bi dich (target device) truoc khi gui RPC. TbSendRPCRequestNode luon gui toi originator nen phai doi originator truoc. entityNamePattern lay ten tu metadata.targetDeviceName.
Gui RPC command toi originator hien tai (da doi sang target device o node truoc). Timeout 30s.
Delay truoc khi thuc hien action tiep theo. Default 5 giay, co the override qua msg.seconds.
Tao alarm tu notification action. App doc alarm va hien thi push notification.
